_about: Operational limits for the gex-only system. Trimmed 2026-07-04: watchlist, alert_throttle, tick, right_eye_gate, and tilt blocks (plus retired model task names) had no readers.

auth._about: Schwab login keep-alive. The refresh token hard-expires 7 days after the interactive login that created it (Schwab policy, no token-only renewal). A daily job checks the token's age and pings the phone to re-auth BEFORE it dies. See the deep-research report.
auth._warn_note: Ping to re-auth once the token is this old — a 1-day buffer before the 7-day wall.
auth._hard_note: Schwab's hard ceiling; the token is dead at/after this age. Do not raise — it just won't work.

ntfy._about: Push channel for alerts + the weekly re-auth ping. A plain HTTPS POST to a public ntfy topic. The topic name IS the credential — ntfy.sh is unauthenticated, so anyone holding it can read every alert and publish fakes. It therefore lives in Keychain (service 'mirai-station-ntfy'), exported as MIRAI_NTFY_TOPIC by runtime/scripts/env.sh, which wins over this value. KEEP 'topic' EMPTY HERE: this file is tracked, and a topic written here is a secret committed to the repo and to every future clone of its history. Empty + no env var = log-only, no send.
ntfy._server_note: Public relay by default; point at a self-hosted ntfy server if you run one.

models._watchtower_note: HEAD B, the reasoning head - PINNED exact id (never an alias): a silently re-pointed alias would change the judge mid-record. Model bump = record reset, same as a prompt bump.

wall_breach._about: The wall-breach bell (intraday/gex_alerts.py): one phone page when SPX pushes concretely through a dealer wall. The engine records the crossing on the diary row; the bell's own fallback check below is for rows without one. (The morning macro brief these knobs once served, and its re-dive of the analyst on a breach, retired 2026-10-11.)
wall_breach._buffer_note: The fallback check rings only when spot pushes past a gamma wall by this fraction of the implied daily move - filters ordinary in-wall pullbacks.
wall_breach._cooldown_note: Min minutes between two pages for the same ticker+wall, so a price riding a level can't spam the phone.
